skills.name: Oracle Brush
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Samsara, Locked
skills.desc:
Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy target, then applies "Burden" to them.
For every 2 Basic ATKs, Skills, or Ultimates allies use on an enemy with "Burden," allies will immediately recover 1 Skill Point. "Burden" is only active on the latest target it is applied to, and will be dispelled automatically after the Skill Point recovery effect has been triggered #2[i] times.

skills.name: Ten-Lords' Decree, All Shall Obey
skills.desc: Increases the SPD of a target ally by #3[f1]% of Hanya's SPD and increases the same target ally's ATK by #1[i]%, lasting for #2[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Sanction
skills.desc: When an ally uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate on an enemy inflicted with Burden, the DMG dealt increases by #1[i]%, lasting for #2[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Netherworld Judgment
skills.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, applies Burden equivalent to that applied by the Skill to a random enemy.

passives.name: Scrivener
passives.desc: Allies triggering Burden's Skill Point recovery effect have their ATK increased by 10% for 1 turn(s).

passives.name: Netherworld
passives.desc: If the trigger count for the Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is 1 or lower when an enemy with Burden is defeated, then additionally recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

passives.name: Reanimated
passives.desc: When Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is triggered, this character regenerates 2 Energy.
